reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved when summarizing branch history.

skipPrompt.description: Skip the branch-summary prompt and default to no summary.

cacheWarming.description: Keep eligible provider prompt caches warm during active runs or, with "idle", between runs. Global setting only.

inlineBudget.description: Estimated tokens (characters / 4) the codemode tool's description may spend on tool declarations. Tools that do not fit are left out and found with searchTools(). 0 lists only namespaces.

mode.description: How the codemode tool presents tools while it is active. on: declared tools get a note on calling them from scripts appended to their description, and codemode lists only tools that are not declared. only: codemode lists every tool scripts can call, and active built-in and extension tools are hidden from the model, so it reaches them through codemode.

collapseChangelog.description: Show a condensed changelog after an update.

modelOverrides.description: Per-model token settings keyed by exact provider/modelId.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the model response.

defaultProjectTrust.description: Fallback project-trust behavior. Can only be set in agent-directory settings.

defaultTools.description: Tools enabled at startup. Plain names replace the defaults; +name adds a tool and -name removes one. An empty array disables all built-in tools but not extension or SDK tools.

doubleEscapeAction.description: Action for double Escape with an empty editor.

editorPaddingX.description: Horizontal editor padding from 0 to 3 cells.

enableAnalytics.description: Opt in to analytics data sharing. Currently used only by the experimental first-run setup.

enableInstallTelemetry.description: Enable anonymous install/update reporting and selected provider attribution headers. Does not control update checks.

enabledModels.description: Model patterns used for startup selection and model cycling. Uses the same format as --models.

externalEditor.description: Command opened by the external-editor keybinding.

followUpMode.description: How queued follow-up messages are delivered.

fullscreenCopyOnSelect.description: Copy selected text automatically in fullscreen mode.

fullscreenExitOutput.description: Output printed when fullscreen mode exits.

fullscreenWheelScrollLines.description: Lines per mouse-wheel event in fullscreen mode, from 1 to 100. "auto" moves one line per event in local macOS terminals, which already accelerate wheel and trackpad input; elsewhere, and over SSH, it speeds up fast wheel spins to at most 6 lines per event. Alt+wheel moves five times as far.

hideThinkingBlock.description: Hide thinking blocks in the transcript.

httpIdleTimeoutMs.description: HTTP header and body idle timeout in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable.

httpProxy.description: Proxy URL applied as HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY for Pi-managed HTTP clients. Can only be set in agent-directory settings.

autoResize.description: Resize images to at most 2000 by 2000 pixels before sending them to a model.

blockImages.description: Prevent images from being sent to models.

codeBlockIndent.description: Prefix used to indent rendered code blocks.

modelThinkingLevels.description: Per-model startup thinking levels keyed by exact provider/modelId.

npmCommand.description: Command and arguments used for npm package lookup and installation.

packages.description: npm, git, or local Pi package sources. See Pi Packages.

quietStartup.description: true hides the startup header and loaded-resource listing. "header" keeps the header (version and key hints) but hides the model scope line and loaded-resource listing.

enabled.description: Enable automatic agent-level retry for transient failures.

maxAgentDelayMs.description: Maximum agent-level retry delay in milliseconds.

maxRetryDelayMs.description: Maximum server-requested delay in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable the limit.

sessionDir.description: Session storage directory. Relative paths resolve from the working directory. PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR and --session-dir override this setting.

shellCommandPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every shell command.

shellPath.description: Custom shell executable path. Supports a leading ~.

showCacheMissNotices.description: Show notices for significant cache misses, successful cache warming, compaction usage, and provider recovery.

showHardwareCursor.description: Show the terminal cursor while Pi positions it for input methods.

steeringMode.description: How queued steering messages are delivered.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear empty rows when rendered content shrinks.

imageWidthCells.description: Preferred inline image width in terminal cells.

showTerminalProgress.description: Show OSC 9;4 progress in the terminal tab.

theme.description: Built-in or custom theme name. system derives colors from the terminal theme.

thinkingBudgets.description: Token budgets for minimal, low, medium, and high thinking levels.

transport.description: Preferred transport for AI providers that support multiple transports.

anthropicExtraUsage.description: Warn when Anthropic subscription authentication may use paid extra usage.

websocketConnectTimeoutMs.description: WebSocket connection timeout in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable.
